# Moonsec Lua Deobfuscator Web

A web-based tool for deobfuscating Moonsec-protected Lua scripts, based on the original [MoonsecDeobfuscator](https://github.com/tupsutumppu/MoonsecDeobfuscator) by tupsutumppu.

## Features

- 🛡️ Deobfuscate Moonsec-protected Lua scripts
- 🔍 Analyze obfuscation levels
- 📝 Syntax highlighting for Lua
- 💾 Download deobfuscated code
- 📊 Code statistics and analysis
- 🌐 Web-based interface
- 🐳 Docker support

## Installation

### Option 1: Docker (Recommended)

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/Moonsec-Deobfuscator-Web.git
cd Moonsec-Deobfuscator-Web

# Start with Docker Compose
docker-compose up -d

# Access the application
# Frontend: http://localhost:8080
# Backend API: http://localhost:5000
